topic: Scientific Models and the Particle Nature of Matter
key_concepts: Scientists use models to explain phenomena that cannot be easily seen or detected.
Models may be physical, computer-based, or pictorial representations.
Models help visualize systems such as the solar system and atoms.
Models can be used to make predictions, such as weather forecasts.
Different atomic models were proposed by different scientists and have limitations.
Atomic models contributed to the development of atomic theory.
Invisible scent particles can spread through sealed bags by diffusion.
The particle model describes solids, liquids, and gases by particle arrangement.
Particles in solids, liquids, and gases differ in arrangement and movement.
Pure substances include elements and compounds.
